dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Not bad! Tastes just like back in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Varka? You're here for the expo, too?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: #Oh hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I was only planning to take a look around. Wasn't expecting this pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Out in this part of the world, even a home-grown Mondstadt apple is a rare treat...

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Yes, and on that note, I should advise you that the prices are quite different from what you'll be used to back home.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Not a problem. It's a price worth paying for a taste of home. I'll take the whole batch, and send someone to collect 'em later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The whole batch? ...Looks like you've already made your money back, huh, Liben?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and Varka — since you're looking for a taste of home, have you tried the Mondstadt wine next door? Apparently, he uses special connections to keep the import costs down.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Yeah, I've tried it. It's pretty good, but not "Mondstadt wine" good.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Besides, I wouldn't be able to buy any even if it was. We can't have the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius going around supporting smugglers, can we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's true... Uh, you're not gonna reprimand him though, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Haha. Don't worry, I know it's Nefer's rules here. Not out to make life difficult for you.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: If you find yourself at a loose end, come visit our base sometime. I'm gonna get the knights to make some cider outta these apples.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It would be my pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: You're as generous as they say, Grand Master.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you've finally made some real profit.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Hey, don't make me sound so incompetent... Though I'll admit, I wasn't expecting to make my money back quite so quickly. Now I can start thinking seriously about my next venture.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where do you plan to make your next fortune?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm planning on heading to Snezhnograd, actually. I hear they're running low on lots of supplies because of Project Stuzha. That's a business opportunity if I've ever seen one.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: With any luck, maybe I'll have the pleasure of seeing you there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, good luck out there! Hope you strike it rich!
